output.target: Whether the disorder in the 2010s case report with a pre-presentation tissue biopsy, upper-body pain and swelling, and earlier stiffness followed by swelling is stiff person syndrome.

subject.description: The disorder in the 2010s case report where an individual had a tissue biopsy two months before presenting with upper-body pain and swelling and had earlier developed stiffness followed by swelling four years later.

required_background.statement: There were two cases in different years that were reported in the 2010s.
The two cases covered a particular disorder shared between two individuals.
In one of the cases, the individual presented with complaints of pain and swelling in the upper part of the body.
In that case, a procedure involving the collection of tissue samples to test for disease had been performed two months earlier.
That individual, when younger, had developed stiffness, which was followed by swelling four years later.
Stiff person syndrome is a condition or syndrome with characteristic symptoms.
